settings.text: We're Shiva and Sankeerthana - two cousins fighting forgetfulness, one memory at a time.

settings.heading: What is an AR frame?
settings.row_content:
A photo frame that comes alive when you scan it with your phone.
Hang it on your wall. Point your camera. Watch your video play - your baby's first steps, your wedding dance, moments you never want to forget.
Your memories, living on your wall instead of buried in your camera roll.

settings.heading: How does the AR frame work?
settings.row_content:
Simple:

1. Order & upload your video/photos
2. We send a preview in 1-2 days
3. You approve
4. We make it
5. Frame arrives - hang it up
6. Open camera → Point → Video plays


Just scan and enjoy. Works on iPhone and Android.

settings.heading: How long until my order arrives?
settings.row_content:
Standard products: (Magnets, Bookmarks, Stickers, Prints): 7-10 days
AR Frames: 7-11 days(includes preview approval time)
Everything is custom-made with YOUR photos. We need time to get it right.

settings.heading: What if my product arrives damaged?
settings.row_content:
Don't panic - we've got you.

  • Take a 10-15 second video showing the damage
  • Email it to support@luxemagics.com within 7 days

We'll respond within 2 business days and make it right.

settings.heading: Can I return a personalized product?
settings.row_content:
No - everything is custom-made with YOUR photos. We can't resell it to anyone else.


BUT: If it's damaged or we made an error, we'll absolutely fix it. Free replacement or full refund.

settings.heading: Do you ship across India?
settings.row_content:
Yes! All major cities and most towns.
Shipping cost:

  • FREE on orders ₹499+
  • ₹49 for orders under ₹499

Not sure if we deliver to your area? Email your pincode to hello@luxemagics.com

All payments are secure. No hidden charges.

settings.heading: Do you do bulk orders for weddings/corporate gifts?
Can I preview my AR frame before you make it?
settings.row_content:
Yes! We send a preview within 1-2 days showing exactly how it'll look.


You must approve before we print. Want changes? Just tell us. We'll adjust and send a new preview.

We don't print until you're 100% happy.
